caption: The drawing consists of two main elements placed on an off-white or beige background. The larger, central object is a detailed black and white sketch of a single shoe, viewed from the side. The shoe has a slightly elevated, thick sole and a lace-up upper with visible stitching and seam lines, rendered with detailed hatching and shading for texture. Above and to the right of the shoe is a smaller, simplified outline sketch of a shoe sole viewed from above, showing the contours and stitching but without shading or interior details. Both drawings appear to be done in pencil, giving them a monotone, grayish-black appearance against the neutral background. The placement and cropping of the elements create a composition that emphasizes both the exterior and bottom view of the shoe.
title: Shoe
